title: Unrestricted router allows unauthorized merkle root setting
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Summary  AmpleEarnRouter.batchSetMerkleRootsStrict() is calling setMerkleRoots() directly without going through EVC. If the intention is to use the router as a payout manager, like in the tests (AmpleEarnRouterTest), this could allow anyone to set merkle roots for any vault and steal payouts.  ## Description  Inside AmpleEarn.setMerkleRoots(), caller authorization is based on _msgSenderOnlyEVCAccountOwner(), which returns msg.sender unless the call comes from the EVC:  ```solidity function setMerkleRoots(     uint256 totalTick
